I wrote `solve.py` in the working folder with `shipping_fee(weight_g, distance_km, express)`. The examples and assertions pass. There was no `./skills` folder, so there were no skill instructions to follow.

The function returns an integer number of satang. Fractions are calculated exactly and rounded half-up at the end.

Sample results:

| weight | distance | express | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,000 g | 10 km | no | 4,000 satang (40.00 baht) |
| 1,001 g | 10 km | no | 8,000 satang |
| 6,000 g | 10 km | no | 9,500 satang |
| 30,000 g | 10 km | no | 45,500 satang |
| 1,000 g | 150 km | no | 4,800 satang |
| 1,000 g | 10 km | yes | 6,000 satang |
| 6,000 g | 150 km | yes | 17,100 satang |

Choices I made where the spec was open:
- **Weight over 5,000 g:** the excess is charged pro-rata by the gram, so 5,001 g adds 0.0015 baht.
- **Distance surcharge:** applies only when distance is strictly greater than 100 km, so exactly 100 km gets no surcharge.
- **Rounding:** half-up to the nearest satang.
- **Invalid input:** weight outside 1–30,000, negative distance, or a non-numeric type raises an exception.
